messages.subject: Error in tag('form',list(...))
parts:
What am I doing wrong?

ui.R

library(shiny)
# Define UI for slider demo application
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(

                        #  Application title
                        headerPanel("Sliders"),

                        # Sidebar with sliders that demonstrate various available options
                        sidebarPanel(
                                     # Número de lançamentos
                                     numericInput("flips", "Lançamentos:",1000),

                                     # Decimal interval with step value
                                     numericInput("p.head", "Probabilidade:",0.5,
                                                  min = 0, max = 1),

                                     # Specification of range within an interval
                                     numericInput("interval", "Intervalo:",0.01),

                                     submitButton(text = "Iniciar"),

                                     checkboxInput(inputId = "show.coin",
                                                   label = strong("Mostrar moeda"),
                                                   value = FALSE),
                                     ),
                        plotOutput(outputId = "main_plot", height = "300px")
          
                        ))     

server.R

library(shiny)
library(plotrix)
# Define server logic for slider examples
shinyServer(function(input, output) {

            output$main_plot <- reactivePlot(function() {  

                                             if (input$p.head > 1 | input$p.head < 0)
                                               stop("p.head must be in the interval [0,1]")
                                             res <- rbinom(n = input$flips, size = 1, prob = input$p.head)
                                             n.trials <- seq(1, input$flips)
                                             cum.s <- cumsum(res)
                                             cum.p <- cum.s/n.trials                                            
                                             if (input$show.coin) {
                                               layout(matrix(c(rep(1, 6), 0, 2, 0), 3, 3, byrow = TRUE))
                                               for (i in 1:input$flips) {
                                                 dev.hold()
                                                 plot(seq(0, input$flips), seq(0, 1, 1/input$flips), type = "n",
                                                      ylab = "Estimated P(Head)", xlab = "Trial", ...)
                                                 abline(h = input$p.head, lty = 2, col = "gray")
                                                 lines(n.trials[1:i], cum.p[1:i], type = "l", col = 2)
                                                 plot(seq(0, 1), seq(0, 1), type = "n", xaxt = "n",
                                                      yaxt = "n", xlab = "", ylab = "", bty = "n")
                                                 draw.circle(x = 0.5, y = 0.5, radius = 0.35, col = rgb(blue = 0.7,
                                                                                                        red = 0.7, green = 0.7, alpha = 0.8))
                                                 text(0.5, 0.5, ifelse(res[i] == 0, "TAIL", "HEAD"),
                                                      cex = 2.1)
                                                 dev.flush()
                                                 Sys.sleep(input$interval)
                                               }
                                             } else {
                                                for (i in 1:input$flips) {
                                                 plot(seq(0, input$flips), seq(0, 1, 1/input$flips), type = "n",
                                                      ylab = "Estimated P(Head)", xlab = "Trial", ...)
                                                 abline(h = input$p.head, lty = 2, col = "gray")
                                                 lines(n.trials[1:i], cum.p[1:i], type = "l", col = 2)
                                               }
                                             } 
})        
})                                                                                      

Thank's
